correctness.rationale: With m=c and µ=e+p/a-r>0, choosing qn<1, q small enough to make xdot/x<=-3µ/4 and δ such that sδ²/c²<µ/4 makes z=x/y decay at least e^{-µt/2}. The forward-invariant wedge makes x decay exponentially while y decreases with ydot of order -y^3. The exact H(y)=c/(s y)+c²/(2s y²) satisfies Hdot=1-nx(y+c)/[y(nx+c)], whose correction is absolutely integrable because x/y is. Inversion gives y=c/(sqrt(2s)) t^{-1/2}+c/(2s)t^{-1}+O(t^{-3/2}). Exact logarithmic prey decomposition -µ-rky+rk²y²+R with integrable R, plus integrals of y and y², proves x~L t^{rkc(kc-1)/(2s)} exp(-µt-rkc sqrt(2/s)sqrt t), L>0. Existence/positivity hold in the actual open wedge, not a global basin.
